ambiguities: M. Verdurin appears only as part of the collective 'les Verdurin et leurs amis' already implicated in the accepted snub against Swann; he has no distinct local outcome of his own. Remi does not appear by name in this passage (only an unnamed 'cocher' is mentioned) and so is not material here. Comte de Forcheville is named twice in Swann's jealous imagining (Odette 'tombant dans les bras de Forcheville', a 'sourire de complicité adressé à Forcheville'), but both mentions are explicitly hedged as hypothetical and possibly never-occurring ('qu'il était possible qu'elle n'eût jamais eue encore'), existing only within Swann's paranoid fantasy rather than as a narrated event; this instability argues against scoring a prestige-association event for him here, though a later or less-hedged passage might warrant it.
